categories.main_business_segments: Anji Microelectronics Technology (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, and industrialization of key semiconductor materials. Its main product lines include chemical mechanical polishing (CMP) slurries, functional wet electronic chemicals, and electroplating solutions and additives, serving integrated circuit manufacturing and advanced packaging sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary core technologies in chemical formulations and process flows, including metal surface oxidation, corrosion inhibition, polishing rate control, CMP surface morphology control, photoresist cleaning, selective etching, electronic-grade additive purification, abrasive preparation, and electroplating additive technologies. Production involves advanced chemical mechanical polishing, wet and dry etching, electrochemical deposition, and precision chemical synthesis, supported by rigorous quality management systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading integrated circuit manufacturers globally, including those producing logic chips, memory chips (3D NAND, DRAM), analog chips, power devices, sensors, and third-generation semiconductors. The company serves both mature and advanced technology nodes, with products widely applied in front-end wafer fabrication and back-end advanced packaging processes.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with significant presence in Shanghai, Ningbo, Beijing, Taiwan, Singapore, and France. It serves global semiconductor markets, with a strategic focus on China and expanding international markets, including Taiwan and other major semiconductor manufacturing hubs.
categories.supply_chain_position: Anji Technology operates primarily in the upstream to midstream segments of the semiconductor materials supply chain, focusing on high-end chemical materials essential for wafer fabrication and advanced packaging processes. It also extends into core raw material production to enhance supply chain security and autonomy.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous innovation and R&D investment, focusing on expanding its '3+1' technology platforms: full-category CMP slurry product matrix, multi-product line functional wet electronic chemicals for leading technology nodes, enhanced electroplating solutions and additives for advanced packaging, and core raw material self-sufficiency. It pursues breakthroughs in advanced process nodes, new materials, and sustainable manufacturing, while strengthening intellectual property and talent development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of semiconductor chemical products to integrated circuit manufacturers. The company employs a direct sales model with customized product development and long-term supply agreements, supplemented by strategic investments and equity income from related enterprises.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Anji Technology has established itself as a leading domestic high-end semiconductor materials supplier, successfully breaking foreign monopolies in CMP slurries and functional wet chemicals. It holds an increasing global market share in CMP slurries (approximately 8% in 2023) and is recognized for its technological leadership and comprehensive product portfolio in China’s semiconductor materials industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 1.24 billion, a 14.96% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders reaching RMB 402.7 million, up 33.6%. Total assets grew 27.14% to RMB 2.6 billion, and net assets increased 39.6% to RMB 2.12 billion. R&D investment accounted for 19.11% of revenue, reflecting strong growth and commitment to innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Anji Technology differentiates itself through proprietary core technologies, comprehensive product lines covering critical semiconductor manufacturing processes, and strong customer-centric customization capabilities. Its focus on high-purity, high-performance materials, supply chain autonomy, and integrated technical support enables customers to optimize processes and improve chip yields, positioning the company as a trusted global partner in advanced semiconductor materials.
